title: Quick Fix British Snapper Pie
description: A quick and flavorful pie filling of snapper fish infused in halal-friendly oil, topped with a shaggy mash of vegetables and served with a tangy mustard sauce.

ingredients.name: Infused Oil
ingredients.notes: use halal-friendly oil such as canola or grapeseed

instructions: Melt 1 tbsp of butter in a pan over medium heat, add the sliced onion and cook until softened
Add the diced carrot and sliced mushroom to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes
In a separate pan, cook the diced potato until tender
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and chicken broth until smooth
Add the whisked mixture to the pan with the onion mixture and stir to combine
Add the cooked snapper fish to the pan and stir to coat with the sauce
Transfer the filling to a pie dish and top with the cooked mashed potato
Dollop the remaining 1 tbsp of butter on top of the mashed potato
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly
Meanwhile, prepare the mustard sauce by whisking together the mustard and milk until smooth
Remove the pie from the oven and serve hot with a dollop of mustard sauce on top
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
